content: Bininj Nawu Birrimak Dja Bininj Nawu Birriwarre.
Psalm 37
Yuwn bu ngurrinjilngwarremen bedberre nawu birriwarre bininj. Dja yuwn bu mak ngurrikirnwe bedberre nawu kabirrikurduyime kunwarre.
Nakka birriwarre bininj wanjh yiman kayime kundalk manbu kahdarlehmen. Dja bedda warridj yiman kayime mankolhdemak, dja kaluk kabirridjalbukmen.
Ngudda wanjh ngurridjalkangekurrmerren nawu Yawey, dja ngurridjalkurduyimen kunmak. Ngurridjaldin kamak rowk kore kurorre.
Ngurrimarnenjilngmarnburrimen kore nawu Yaweykenh. Dja nungka wanjh ngunwon kunmakmak kore ngurridjare.
Ngurrikurrmerrimen kore Yawey bu ngunbolhbukkan dja mak ngunnahnan. Ngurrikangekurrmerren kore nungka, dja nungka ngunmarnekurduyime kunmakkenh.
Kaluk nungka ngunmarnbun ba bu ngurrimak bininj, yiman kayime ngurrikukbame! Nungka mak ngundjadme dja ngunmakwan, ba ngurribolkwolkan yiman kayime manbu kundungbang.
Ngurridjaldin dja ngurridjalmadbun yeledj nawu Yawey, dja yuwn bu ngurrinjilngwarremen bininj bedberre nawu kabirrikurduyime kunwarre kore kabirrikarremarnburren.
Yuwn bu mak ngurriyiddung bedberre. Dja yuwn bu ngurrbenburrbun munguyh. Wardi kunmekbe ngurrimarnburren ngudmandeleng bu ngurriyime kunwarre.
Kaluk birrimekbe nawu birriwarre bininj, wanjh God kabenngeydadjke. Ngudda nawu ngurridjalmadbun nawu Yawey, wanjh nungka ngunbolkwon kunbolk nuye.
Med, dja darnkih kabolkyime wanjh nawu birriwarre bininj kabirridjalyakmen. Bu kuhni ngurrbenyawan, wanjh bonj, minj ngurrbenngalke.
Dja bininj nawu minj kabirriburlumerren wanjh kabirribolkmang dja kabirridjalngehme, kunmodmikenh dorrengh.
Bininj nawu birriwarre, wanjh kabindimarnekarremarnburren kunwarrekenh bedberre birrimak bininj, dja kabindimarneyidmebayerren.
Dja nawu Kawohrnan Rowk kabendjaldjekme nawu birriwarre bininj. Kaluk nungka kaburrbun kore kabolkyime bu nungka kabendjadme bedberre.
Nawu birriwarre bininj kabirrikarrme mandjawakkimuk, dja bonarra kabirrikarrme, ba bu kabindibun nawu birrimarladj dja mak nawu minj birrikuken. Bedda kabirridjare kabindibun nawu birrimak bininj.
Dja ngaleng nawu mandjawakkimuk kabirrikarrme wanjh kabirrikangeduluburren. Dja nawu bonarra bedberre wanjh kadjalbakme rowk.
Bininj nawu birrimak minj birrikuken, dja kamak rowk! Bininj birriwern nawu birridjalwarre, wanjh kabirrikarrme kunwern, dja wanjh kawarre!
Nawu birriwarre bininj bedberre kundulkarre, wanjh karrulkarreyakmen rowk. Dja nawu Yawey kabenbidyikarrme nawu birrimak bininj.
Bininj nawu minj kabirriyime kunwarre, wanjh nawu Yawey kabennahnan munguyh. Dja kabenmarnekarrme kunmakmak kore kadjehdjenyo munguyh.
Bu kunrayek kabenmarnebebme nawu birrimak bininj, wanjh kabirridjalre kamak. Bu manme yak kore kunbolk rowk, wanjh bedda minj kabirrimarrwe, dja kabirriworrkmiworren.
Dja nawu birriwarre bininj kabirridjalyakmen rowk. Nawu birriyidko nawu Yawey, wanjh kabirridjalyakmen yiman kayime mannguymak, dja yiman kayime kundolng kare.
Nawu birriwarre bininj wanjh kabirridjalmang njalehnjale, dja minj kabindimarnedurndiwe bedberre nawu birrikarrmi. Dja ngaleng birrimak bininj wanjh birridjalnjilngmak bu kabirriweykan njalehnjale.
Bininj nawu Yawey kabenmarneyime kunmak, wanjh kabirribolkmang dja kabirrihyo kore kubolkmak. Dja bininj nawu Yawey kabenwarrewan, wanjh kabenngeydadjke bedberre.
Bininj nawu kadjare kabirridjare kabirribolhkadjung nuye Yawey, wanjh Yawey kabenbidyikarrme ba minj kabirrimankan.
Wardi bu namak bininj kabungbarrkbun, wanjh minj kamankan kunkimukkenh. Nawu Yawey kaberlyirriyongen dja kabikarrme.
Ngaye wanjh ngayawurrinjni, dja wanjh bolkkime ngaye ngakohbanj, dja minj ngabennayinj bininj nawu birrimak bu kunrayek kabenbularrbun, dja wurdwurd bedberre minj mak kabirriwernhmarrwedowen.
Bedda wanjh kabirrinjilngmak bu kabindiwon njalehnjale kore birrimarladj bininj, dja nawu wurdwurd bedberre, wanjh God kabenmarneyime kunmak.
Mah, ngurribawo kunwarre, dja ngurridjalkurduyimen bu djal kunmak. Bu kuhni ngurriyime, wanjh ngurridjalyo munguyh kore kubolkmak.

Bu kuhnikenh, nawu Yawey kabenmarnedjare bininj nawu kabirrikurduyime bu dja mandjadkenh. Dja minj mak kabenbawon nawu nuye birrimak bininj. Nungka kabenmarnebiddjurruddi bu munguyh. Dja nawu birriwarre bininj, wanjh Yawey kabenburriwe nawu bedberre wurdwurd.
Yawey kabenwon kunbolk bedberre nawu birridjalmak ba bu kabirridjalyo kumekbe bu munguyh munguyh.
Nawu namak bininj kawokdi bu kunmakkenh, kore God nuye kunmayali, dja bu kawokdi wanjh mandjad duninjh.
Nungka wanjh kaburrbun God nuye mankarre kore kukange, dja kadjalre kore manbolhmak dja minj kamankan.
Nawu birriwarre bininj kabirridjare kabindibun nawu birrimak bininj, dja kabindimarnewarlkkarren ba kabindidarrkidmang.
Dja nawu Yawey minj kabenbawon bu kabindibun. Bu birriwarre bininj kabindidjadme, wanjh Yawey kabenbidyikarrme bininj birrimak.

Mah, dja ngurridjalmadbun nawu Yawey, dja ngurridjalmarrkmang kore ngunbukkan. Wanjh nungka ngunngeykimukwon ba bu ngunbolkwon ngudberre kunbolk. Kaluk bu nungka kabenburriwe nawu birriwarre bininj, wanjh ngudda ngurrbennan kore kabenmarnekurduyimerran.
Ngaye ngakurdunang bininj nabang dja nawu nawarreni. Wanjh nungka wernhkimukworrinj yiman kayime kundulmak bu kadjordmen kore kundjulngmak ngalengngarre.
Dja bonj, nungka wanjh werrkwerrk djalyakminj rowk! Ngaye ngayawam, dja larrk, yakminj, bonj.
Ngurrbenngunjdjikka bininj nawu minj kabirriyime kunwarre, dja kabirridjalkurduyime kunmak! Bininj nawu kadjare kunmodmikenh, wanjh nakka kahre munguyh.
Dja ngaleng bininj nawu birriwarre, wanjh kabirribularrbuyindan. Minj kabirrire munguyh.
Nawu Yawey kabenngehke birrimak bininj, dja nungka yiman kayime kabendjurruddi bedberre munguyh, ba bu kabirridjarrkdi nuye bu kunyid kabenmarnewernmerren.
Yawey kabenbidyikarrme dja mak kabenbebke kore birriwarre bininj kabindibongkarrme, dja mak kabenngehke munguyh. Kunmekbekenh kunu bedda wanjh kabirridjalwarlkkarren kore nungka kabennahnan.
